summary: @servicetitan/component-usage 28.5.7 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: On `npm install`, the `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from GitHub releases to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped at the tarball root. `setup.mjs` is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers and per-function string maps. `math_init.js` is an approximately 727 KB compiled-Bun bundle beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs` and a shifted string-array decoder — opaque bytes that cannot be reviewed statically and are executed automatically at install time under a runtime that bypasses Node-based tooling. The package's declared purpose is component usage metrics via Datadog, which does not require Bun. Additionally, `package.json` declares `files: ["bin","dist","src","static"]`, but both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` reside at the tarball root outside those declared paths, indicating they were not part of the maintainer's declared publish surface. The combination of an install-time alternate-runtime drop, an obfuscated compiled-Bun payload, an unrelated advertised purpose, and undeclared tarball blobs matches the shape of a compromised-publisher supply-chain attack.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
